title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 4
summary: Oil slid to the lowest in over three weeks as optimism grew that the US and Iran are moving closer to an agreement that would reopen the vital Strait of Hormuz chokepoint.

title: Jefferies Gets New Evidence of Fake Invoices at Troubled Fund
summary: Jeffries has found new evidence that invoices underpinning its financing to an iron ore trader called Sapphire Minmetals Corp. are fake. This discovery comes after Jeffries was already reviewing its exposure to iron ore trader Radiant World, after reports that documents provided to financers were not valid. Bloomberg's Sri Natarajan reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Wayfair Sees Momentum as Stores, High-End Goods Draw Consumers
summary: Kate Gulliver, CFO at Wayfair, said that the momentum the furniture company is seeing is the result of initiatives building up over time as Wayfair tries to improve the customer experience. Gulliver also discussed what kind of consumers are buying from Wayfair. She said that the company is seeing momentum from the higher-end consumer with the inclusion of a premium brand 'Perigold' and is drawing in new customers with brick-and-mortar stores.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Treasuries Rise as Falling Oil Prices Ease Pressure on Fed
summary: Treasuries rose on Tuesday as signs of progress toward a diplomatic resolution of the Iran war sent oil prices lower, curbing expectations for more than one Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in the coming year.

title: Jefferies Gets Evidence of Fake Invoices at Trouble Fund
summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. has been told that some of the invoices underpinning its financing to an iron ore trader called Sapphire Minmetals Corp. are not genuine, according to people familiar with the matter. Sapphire Minmetals denies the "rumors." Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Boom Is ‘Trickling Down’ to Old-Line Stocks, Wells Fargo Says
summary: The flood of AI spending by big tech companies is “trickling down to the broader economy,” according to Wells Fargo & Co., which says that’s poised to push up industrial stocks.

title: S&P 500 Set for All-Time Highs on Hormuz Deal Push: Markets Wrap
summary: Hopes for an agreement to revive the Strait of Hormuz lifted stocks toward all-time highs, bonds climbed and oil sank, with Wall Street’s enthusiasm also fueled by a batch of solid corporate earnings.

title: El problema del yen ya preocupa también a Estados Unidos
summary: El yen japonés se fortaleció con fuerza después de que el gobierno estadounidense interviniera en el mercado cambiario. Pero, ¿por qué la moneda estaba tan débil y qué hay detrás de esa decisión? (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Codelco Halts Expansion Work at Top Mine on New Seismic Risk
summary: Codelco is suspending work on a project designed to extend the life of its biggest copper mine in Chile after identifying a new source of seismic risk a year after a rock burst killed six workers.

title: SpaceX’s First Earnings Offer a Chance to Reverse Stock’s Plunge
summary: SpaceX’s first earnings release following its record initial public offering is one of the most anticipated reports of the summer for traders on Wall Street and beyond. Whether it’ll give investors a reason to buy the sinking stock is another matter.

title: 'Inevitable' US, Iran Will See More Volatility In Coming Months, Says Suzanne Maloney
summary: Suzanne Maloney, vice president and director for foreign policy at The Brookings Institution, said that she expects volatility between the US and Iran to continue in the coming months regardless of whether or not the countries reach a deal on the Strait of Hormuz and that volatility will be a 'function of Persian Gulf economics for the foreseeable future.' Maloney also weighed in on the US weapons stockpile, saying that she believes that the availability of munitions has been driving strategic decision making for some time.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Sundial’s Richelieu Dennis on Revolt Stake, Essence Fest
summary: Bloomberg's Romaine Bosick sits down with Richelieu Dennis, Founder and Chair of The Sundial Group of Companies, as his brand Essence Ventures makes a strategic investment in Revolt's parent company, Offscript Worldwide. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Copper Tops $14,000 as US Stockpiles Swell Before Tariff Call
summary: Copper advanced to its highest level since mid-May, topping $14,000 a ton in London, as traders monitored ballooning volumes held in the US ahead of an expected decision on an import tariff by President Donald Trump.

title: Wegovy Pill Sales Don’t Live Up to Wall Street Obesity Hype
summary: Novo Nordisk A/S raised its forecasts for the second time this year on a rosy outlook for its obesity and diabetes drugs, though the firm’s US shares fell as sales of the new Wegovy weight-loss pill failed to top analysts’ expectations.

title: Thoma Bravo Sells Majority Stake in Command Alkon to Francisco Partners
summary: Buyout firm Francisco Partners has agreed to acquire a majority stake in construction software maker Command Alkon Inc. from Thoma Bravo, underscoring investor interest in software crucial to specific industries.

title: S&P 500 Rally Faces Earnings Test | Open Interest 8/4/2026
summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." A new S&P 500 record is in sight as earnings put the rally to the test. SpaceX and Palantir take center stage, while oil slides on hopes for a US and Iran breakthrough. Plus, Redd Brown joins us on McDonald’s leadership shakeup, Bob Sloan of S3 says SpaceX is the "frothiest trade the market has even seen." Phantom CEO Jim Cantrell takes a deep dive into the space boom, and Goldman's Amanda Lynam joins us with a look at hidden credit stress. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: OPEC Output Rose in July Led by Gulf Nations, Survey Shows
summary: OPEC’s crude oil production recouped some more of its wartime losses last month with gains in Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and Iraq, though opaque shipping data complicated the process of tracking the group’s output, a Bloomberg survey showed.
